sections_target.text: This document sets out the steps for the quarterly inspection of the fire-fighting and cooling system on the diesel tanks.

The system consists of a foam concentrate tank of 20,000 litres capacity, from which the foam lines run to diesel tanks 1 and 2 through the pump installed after the foam tank; the tanks are also cooled by water sprinklers distributed over each tank.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Magid El-Henawy, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Magid Sawan, Head of Nubaria Power Station Sector.

It was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and the document was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and certified by Eng. rows: Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card.
Fence off the place to define the work area and put up warning signs.
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...).
Complete tool bag
Cleaning fluids
Check all the main parts of the system
Make sure the water supply source is working well
Make sure all the gauges are in good condition and read correctly.
Make sure the supply water pressure is suitable for operating the system
Make sure the foam tank level is suitable
Make sure all the valves on the foam line are open and in good condition
Make sure there are no water leaks in the system line
Make sure the main drain valve is working
Make sure the auxiliary drain valve is working
Make sure all the sprinklers are in good visible condition.
Make sure the fire extinguishing system monitoring panel is working
Make sure there are no alarms or problems on the fire system monitoring panel
Make sure the earthing of the tank body is sound
Make sure the lightning arresters are sound.

Introduction
This document sets out the steps for the quarterly inspection of the fire-fighting and cooling system on the diesel tanks.
The system consists of a foam concentrate tank of 20,000 litres capacity, from which the foam lines run to diesel tanks 1 and 2 through the pump installed after the foam tank; the tanks are also cooled by water sprinklers distributed over each tank.
The first draft was prepared by Eng. Ahmed Mohamed El-Mohtady Qamra, tested by Eng. Abdel Magid El-Henawy, and reviewed by
Eng. El-Said Shaaban Abdel Qader, approved by Eng. Magdy Okba, General Manager of Boiler Maintenance, and approved by Eng. Ahmed Abdel Magid Sawan, Head of Nubaria Power Station Sector.
It was reviewed by Chemist Ibrahim Youssef Youssef, Occupational Safety and Health Inspector in the Inspection Sector, and the document was approved by Eng. Samir Abdel Galil, General Manager of Inspection and Quality Control at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company and the company's coordinator for the Maintenance Procedures Information System, and certified by Eng. Mohamed Naguib Abdel Hay, Head of the Inspection and Quality Control Sector at the Middle Delta Electricity Production Company.
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work order from the competent authority; those carrying out the maintenance must hold an Occupational Safety and Health category card. | 
Fence off the place to define the work area and put up warning signs. | 
Follow the occupational safety and health procedures for personnel and equipment and wear personal protective equipment (safety helmet, safety shoes, overalls, gloves, ...). | 
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Complete tool bag | 
Cleaning fluids |

Check all the main parts of the system |

Make sure there are no water leaks in the system line | 7.
Make sure the main drain valve is working | 8.
Make sure the auxiliary drain valve is working | 9.
Make sure all the sprinklers are in good visible condition. | 10.
Make sure the fire extinguishing system monitoring panel is working | 11.
Make sure there are no alarms or problems on the fire system monitoring panel | 12.
Make sure the earthing of the tank body is sound | 13.
Make sure the lightning arresters are sound. | 14.
